limitations: Previously exposed internal thesis test cases; not a new untouched or external test.
Historical comparator checkpoint identity is unknown; this is not a controlled same-weights fast-versus-reference equivalence experiment.
26-connected annotation islands are engineering components, not adjudicated distinct clinical lesions.
No retraining, annotation-derived inference ROI, equivalence, superiority or clinical-readiness claim.

metric_protocol.empty_policy: Both empty: Dice/IoU=1, HD95/ASSD=0. Zero precision/recall denominator or exactly one empty surface: null. Report undefined counts; report tumor-positive subset separately.
metric_protocol.surface: 6-connected boundary voxels; HD95 of pooled bidirectional distances; ASSD pooled mean; physical millimetres
metric_protocol.lesions: 26-connected components; one-to-one maximum-cardinality match; no small-component filtering
metric_protocol.bootstrap: Percentile 95% CI of macro mean, case unit, undefined values excluded; no CI for n<2. Pooled lesion ratios resample whole cases.

paired.difference_direction: left minus right; positive overlap/recall/precision favors left, negative distance favors left
